text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, King Halo was booked for a 
magazine interview.

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Your casual clothes look great too~! So 
natural and elegant!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems my first-class presence 
shines through even when I'm not trying!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, that wraps up the photoshoot in the 
school uniform, gym uniform, and casual 
clothes, but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To showcase so many different sides of 
King... It certainly lives up to being a 
special feature article.
choice_data_list:
You're getting so much attention, it's 
amazing.

You're really getting a lot of attention, 
that's amazing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! Honestly, they could feature 
me a lot more and it still wouldn't be 
enough!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we move on to the next shoot? I 
wonder what kind of King I should show 
them this time?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting, I'm all changed.

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! You look so 
picturesque in your racing racewear too~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right? Exactly! After all, it is King who 
is wearing it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going out for my run, so 
make sure to get the best shot!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Her running form is picture-perfect too~! 
Chest high, chin up! She looks truly 
gallant!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as I watched King Halo's 
photoshoot—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Are you taking pictures of 
King!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
King-chan looks so cool in her racing 
silks, doesn't she!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You really look great in whatever you 
wear~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Her going-out clothes and the 
loungewear she wears in her room all suit 
her so well!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But King-chan did say herself that 
her racing outfit suits her best~
choice_data_list: Were you saying things like that?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It happened a little while ago, 
though—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What is that outfit?! A new one?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this is my racewear!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Racewear is what you wear during races, 
right? You got yours?! Lucky you, I'm so 
jealous~!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I can finally wear my Racewear... The 
outfit I wanted to wear the most, the one 
most suited for me."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...However, slipping into this outfit 
isn't the finish line. If anything, it's 
just the start!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Start...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: My mother is a racing outfit designer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, in its own way... she does seem to 
be designing clothes that bring out each 
Umamusume's unique charm, though.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So your mother made those clothes for you 
too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"No way! Someone else designed this. 
There's no way Mother would make one for 
me."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, that person might have design 
sense, but she has no eye for Umamusume 
themselves."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why I'm going to show them! By 
letting them see me win in this racing 
outfit!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right, I'll have to keep it safe and sound 
until then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah--!! I spilled my juice! My racing 
outfit is ruined--!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea what they were talking about 
halfway through, but she's gonna put on 
her racewear and do her best!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"It seems you hold extraordinary feelings 
toward your racewear."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Phew... I wonder if I took good photos?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Since it even includes photos of you in 
your racing silks, the special feature 
article is bound to be a massive hit!
choice_data_list:
Let's win tons of races wearing those 
clothes!

Let's wear that outfit and win lots of 
races!
That racing outfit looks great on you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Since it even includes photos of you in 
your racing silks, the special feature 
article is bound to be a massive hit!
choice_data_list:
Let's win tons of races wearing those 
clothes!

Let's wear that outfit and win lots of 
races!
That racing outfit looks great on you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh... What's this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it obvious? After all, I am King 
Halo!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To prove that I am first-rate, I will win 
across many grand stages! O-ho-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Acting the same as ever, beneath the 
surface lay King Halo's deep feelings 
invested in her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, you're unusually compliant today. Has 
it finally sunk in for you, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hey.Don't stare at me like 
that."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is it dirty somewhere!? I thought I 
completely got rid of that juice stain!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps because of her desire to seize 
victory while wearing this outfit, her 
racing silks looked more fitting on her 
than anything else."
